notes.title: Patch 1.09
notes.content:
Monday Patch Day!

https://i.imgur.com/4ZCEUZJ.jpg


 Increase XP earned from raid missions by 50%
 New effects to indicate that Mr Moon is immune to most damage
 Fixed bug: Cancelling spec ops doesn't clear equipment
 Fixed bug: Arrows and toy arrows add to notification icon over Armory even though you can't upgrade them

If you've discovered a bug please feel encouraged to post here on the Steam forums or contact us directly, including your player log at: kenny@kennysun.com. Just put "BUG" in the subject bar.

That's all for today, thank you for your continued support and the positive reviews which are helping us to reach new players!

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
Wonderful Patch Wednesday

"I sowed these patches with my own hands."  - Charlie "Patches" McGee

https://i.imgur.com/Ta82sHD.jpg

Hello again dear community! We have another patch today including some key pieces of feedback from our forums and bug inbox.

Some folks are happier basking in the completionism phase at the end of a full campaign run, and others want to move on to NG+ as soon as possible. We have a warning to indicate when you're going to pass the point of no return with your campaign/save progress.

We also made things a little trickier in NG+ where you will go back to losing a map piece if you lose a Hat Heist mission. 


 Add warning (in English only for now) about final mission
 Add support for ultrawide monitors
 Lose map piece on failing hat heist in New Game+
 Fixed bug: Restart feature in New Game+ sometimes overrides the wrong slot


Please feel encouraged to contact us directly with a video clip of your bug, and your player log at: kenny@kennysun.com. Just put "BUG" in the subject bar.

Your logs (Player.log and Player-prev.log) should be in "C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\Kenny Sun\Hatbox.

That's all for today, thank you for your continued support and the positive reviews which are helping us to reach new players!

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
Tantalizing Tuesday Patch


https://i.imgur.com/sOuzxpN.jpg

As promised, we're reviewing feedback, re-reviewing, reviewing the re-reviews, and making changes to help sculpt this Hatbox into something Michelangelo himself could only dream of. 

We're trying to strike a balance between overcoming challenges but not being unnecessarily punished for slipping up along the way. 

Patch 1.04:


 No longer lose your unit if you quit the game in the middle of a mission
 No longer lose a map piece when you fail a hat heist
 Fixed bug: Tranquilizers stun you forever
 Potentially fixed bug where you can get stuck floating above a platform unable to jump



Your feedback is paramount and we really really appreciate it so please feel encouraged to keep it coming.

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
Two Patch Monday
"[strike]Do it once and do it right.[/strike] Do it twice and do it better."


https://i.imgur.com/gq8Cm7a.jpg


We ran into an issue with the latest patch causing problems for users who were initiating a new save from the demo. While we were at it, we compiled our latest fixes.

Patch 1.03 Notes:


 Fixed bug: If you use a camera while you have the Technophobe quirk, the HUD gets re-enabled
 Fixed bug: The tutorial for equipping 2 hats can block input if you select a mission where equipment is not allowed
 Fixed bug: Frogs can eat enemies that you're in the middle of capturing
 Fixed bug: You can get damaged when exiting level and an enemy with a spiky hat walks past the doorway
 Fixed bug: Main menu breaks after you start up the game for the first time and played the demo previously


Keep sharing your feedback, and if you haven't done so yet, please consider leaving a nice review so Steam will be kind to our indie effort and visibility!

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Happy Patch Monday!

https://i.imgur.com/2UCUd1l.jpg

Thank you to everyone who has been helping us by reporting issues and sending us details of how they came about. We're working hard on patches so you can expect them to be pretty consistent, and small in size as to have a low impact on downloading/updating. You might not even notice them patch on, we're stealthy like that!

We LOVE that you are enjoying our game and we want to help craft your player experience into something that feels just  right. So we're taking all of the feedback that you provided over the weekend, preparing some exceedingly large cups of coffee and figuring out where we can make improvements. 

For now, here's this morning patch notes:


 Increase number of starter units to 5
 Give 4 of those starter units a non-negative quirk
 Give one starter unit only 2 negative quirks
 Fixed Bug: Tutorial occasionally doesn't detect that you have a Showroom and prevents you from moving forward
 Fixed Bug: If you have the Quick Draw quirk, the toy bow will use the normal bow's animation when drawing it



Please feel encouraged to contact us directly with a video clip of your bug and player log at: kenny@kennysun.com. Just put "BUG" in the subject bar. 

Your logs (Player.log and Player-prev.log) should be in "C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\Kenny Sun\Hatbox.

That's all for today but you can expect us to be staying very much on top of improving with consistency.

Thank you again for supporting us early, and for leaving positive reviews which are so so important for us at this early stage!

notes.title: MR SUN'S HATBOX IS OUT NOW! | QUIRKS, QUIRKS, QUIRKS!
notes.content:
In Mr Sun's Hatbox, the minions that you capture and brainwash have a variety of quirks that can make missions harder or easier.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40965710/317807be7044732f95c028eb8771b3db3e985bd2.gif

These quirks mean you have to take into consideration who's best suited to take on each mission.

Take our friend 'Cinema' Santos, for example.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40965710/74ec0ebfe84791e6bff10ed5020a8ab9dc30b5c5.gif

He's asthmatic (not ideal, but it's unlikely we'll encounter much smoke)
He's squeamish (he faints when snapping necks... VERY not ideal, but we can work with it)
And he's Photogenic (not ideal... Unless you're doing a raid. Raid's automatically set off the alarms at the start of the level, so it makes no difference)

Let's see him in action.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40965710/85e2e6697413bd460761ef1644e331e4a8fbf365.gif
Ouch! Slightly inconvenient, but should be fine.

Some minions have so many quirks that the game becomes incredibly difficult to play!

Take our OTHER friend, 'Shotgun' Stuart.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40965710/f5da2a85348119c8c39dec6ef567b447b44b7bf0.gif

He has... A lot of quirks.

Bad ones.

Let's see them in action.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40965710/f3b12de05b283b49e15d99c3d10417379f3d00e8.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40965710/e837ca2fed0ed78fd4856c18807acaac59eeffca.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40965710/fc9ec7c2698030dbd237044a0f474a8afb91cab8.gif
Uhh, yeah. Not good.

This is small insight into how quirks can affect gameplay... Why not explore the many other quirks you can find in Mr Sun's Hatbox yourself today?

See you then!

notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
A hatbox making its way to Mr Sun has been stolen by Mr Moon and we need YOU to retrieve it using any means necessary.

At Gamescom, PAX, and Tokyo Game Show, many tried to rescue the hatbox from Mr Moon’s grubby hands, but few were as skilled as you. 

Your reputation precedes you, dear reader. Your capacity to jump, slap, smash, shoot and fart is spoken of worldwide. Still, we need to ensure you’re prepared for the challenge. Which brings us to your delivery mission…

DELIVERY MISSION: Play The Demo

The Mr Sun’s Hatbox demo allows you to play through the first hat heist (... and beyond?)

Staff Room - Manage your workers and assign them to jobs

Remember, this is only a taster of the full game, so if you like what you see, there’s plenty more to get excited for!

Good luck. The fate of Mr Sun's hatbox is in your hands.
